data.title: Bitcoin and ethereum prices today, Tuesday, September 15, 2026: Crypto prices sliding this morning ahead of Fed meeting
data.description: Bitcoin opened at $78,181.33 on Tuesday, September 15, 2026, 1.8% higher than Monday's opening price. Yet, as of 7:24 a.m. ET this morning, the price of bitcoin slid to $76,931.56. Ethereum opened at $2,515.17 today, up 1.6% from Monday's opening price. Ethereum fell to $2,480.37 as of 7:24 a.m. ET.
